name: adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 'Dazzling Blue'
story_html: The adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 ‘Dazzling Blue’ delivers a two-tone colorway of Kanye West’s popular lifestyle runner. The minimalist upper features flexible Primeknit construction, pitched to a solid black hue with contrasting threads woven throughout. A streak of royal blue cuts through the lateral side, complete with signature SPLY-350 branding. Responsive cushioning is provided by a full-length Boost midsole, entirely wrapped in a semi-translucent TPU cage for added durability.
